prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is active on your screen. Practice positioning and interacting with them now.", "Finish Setup & Launch", "Desktop Overlay Preview", "Your pet is ready to live on your desktop!"]
1: ["Choose Your Ready-to-Adopt Pet", "Select one of our popular ready-made companions or start fresh.", "Adopt Selected Pet", "Starter Pet Archetypes"]
2: ["Next: Quick Controls", "Quick Desktop Controls", "Learn how to interact with your pet anytime from your taskbar or keyboard.", "Start Playing", "Click pet to chat | Right-click for menu | Drag to move", "Test Summon Key"]
3: ["Continue to Name Pet", "Give Your Pet a Name & Trait", "Personalize your pet's personality before we issue their official certificate.", "Create Certificate", "Pet Name", "Personality Trait"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet...", "We are generating high-res desktop animations. Explore tips while you wait!", "Generation Progress", "Did you know? You can customize desktop sounds later in settings."]
5: ["If authentication window does not open, check browser pop-up blockers or click Retry.", "Troubleshoot Sign-In"]
6: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet", "Linking an account saves your pet's identity and items safely in the cloud.", "Automatic Cloud Backup Enabled"]
7: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Pick quick setup for instant fun or custom setup for a tailored pet.", "Onboarding Paths"]
8: ["Takes less than 2 minutes to complete setup."]
9: ["Play Ready Chime", "Your pet will notify you with a sound when ready!"]
